description: ADO-TXN nesting on a read/write Connection: BeginTrans three times, each returned level read and S of ID 1, 2 and 3 updated to "L1", "L2", "L3" after the matching level; CommitTrans (level 3), RollbackTrans (level 2), stored rows read; CommitTrans (level 1), stored rows read; a fresh pair BeginTrans, BeginTrans, UPDATE of S of ID 4, CommitTrans, RollbackTrans, stored rows read; then a CommitTrans of an outer level while the inner is still open (stored rows, Errors). Asks the returned levels, what a committed inner level contributes to an outer rollback and how out-of-order resolution answers.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
